fact: The 2018 yearbook (December 2019) states that first-level facilities (CS and CSA) send monthly reports to district teams for entry in DHIS2, while communal medical centres and prefectural, regional and national hospitals enter directly each month.
title: Annuaire statistiques sanitaires 2018
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement, SNIS
